code.label: representation.identifier.numeric_code
code.why: BLS's SOC code at every level, two digits, a hyphen and four digits (11-1011). Inferred, finetype reads it as an Australian bank-state-branch number, which it is not. finetype has no SOC type yet, so the column is nominated the label for a classification code whose digits carry meaning; its pattern admits digits only, so describe widens it for the hyphen, and the overrides declare the NN-NNNN shape the column holds.

code_display.label: representation.identifier.numeric_code
code_display.why: BLS's SOC code as BLS prints it, the same as code, two digits, a hyphen and four digits (11-1011). Inferred, finetype reads it as an ordinal date and the descriptor would type the column as a date, which it is not. finetype has no SOC type yet, so the column is nominated the label for a classification code whose digits carry meaning; its pattern admits digits only, so describe widens it for the hyphen, and the overrides declare the NN-NNNN shape the column holds.

description.label: representation.text.plain_text
description.why: BLS's title for a group or occupation, such as Chief Executives. Inferred, finetype labels it an entity name, an organisation's or product's name, which it is not; it is prose naming work.

release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The edition's reference year and BLS's update date, 2018/2020-04-15: an identifier for the snapshot, stored as text as every code list's release is. Inferred it is `unknown`; it is not a date, since the year in front is the edition.

text_source.label: representation.text.word
text_source.why: A closed set of one value, bls. Inferred it is `unknown`; the value is one short token.

definition.label: representation.text.plain_text
definition.why: BLS's definition of a detailed occupation, sentences up to 828 characters. Inferred it is `unknown`, which publishes no length bounds; it is prose.
